title: Linebender Wiki Article Breaks Down Squircles for UI Graphics
summary: The Linebender wiki has published a reference page on squircles — the superellipse-like rounded-rectangle shapes used in UI and graphics work — posted by raphlinus. The page covers the shapes&\#x27; geometric properties and why their smoother corner transitions matter when drawing interfaces and curves. It is explanatory documentation rather than a release; the supplied material contains no formulas, code, or measurements from the page itself.
